notes.say: Thank you for the kickoff call. This deck is our plan for getting Larkspur found by new patients in Boise and Meridian. It follows what you told us and the research we did since.
notes.emphasise: Emergency care is the opening no competitor has taken.
notes.pushback: You asked for a twenty-page site. The agreed scope is up to 12 pages, and slide 14 explains how the plan works within it.

notes.say: Larkspur has no website today, so nobody searching for a dentist in Boise or Meridian can land on it. That is the one problem the rest of this plan solves.
notes.pushback: Why not just buy ads? Paid media is outside the agreed scope, and a site is the base any ad would send people to.

notes.pushback: Are the traffic numbers exact? No. They are estimates from a third-party tool, and we label them that way.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Maya Okafor

notes.say: These are your words from the kickoff call. Each one shaped a decision in the plan: what leads the homepage, who the site speaks to and how it sounds.
notes.pushback: Will the site sound salesy? No. Calm, clear, no pressure is the voice we write in.

notes.say: This section shows where Larkspur stands today and who it is up against.
notes.emphasise: The gap to close is authority, not service quality.
notes.pushback: Is the gap too big to close? It is a real gap, and the plan is built to close it in stages.

notes.say: Search presence starts from zero. The review rating is the real asset: 4.9 from 212 Google reviews, and the site will put it in front of every visitor.
notes.pushback: Do reviews matter for search? They build trust on the page, and we keep them current and visible.

notes.say: We compared the new domain with the three Boise practices you named. Treasure Valley Smiles leads on rankings and links. Boise Bright Dental leads on AI citations.
notes.emphasise: Treasure Valley Smiles: 146 top-10 keywords and 312 referring domains.
notes.pushback: Should we copy the leader? We learn from it, but we win first where it has no page, which is emergency care.

slides.headline: Two competitors are real threats and one only looks intimidating

items.name: treasurevalleysmiles.com
items.why: Leads local search on rankings and links, has a page for every treatment, and shows 64 published reviews on its implant page.

items.name: boisebrightdental.com
items.why: Leads on AI citations because it answers cost questions directly. That is the ground our implant cost guide goes after.

items.name: northendfamilydental.com
items.why: Smallest of the three, with 12.8% of traffic, and it has no page for sedation or anxious patients, where Larkspur is strongest.

notes.say: Not every competitor deserves the same worry. Two of them matter. North End Family Dental is smaller and has a clear gap on sedation.
notes.emphasise: Treasure Valley Smiles and Boise Bright Dental are the two to watch.
notes.pushback: Why not call all three real threats? Because the figures show North End is well behind, and we should spend effort where it counts.

notes.pushback: Why not go for it first? A new domain would struggle, and the lower-difficulty pages bring patients sooner.

notes.say: This section covers how Larkspur is positioned, the site we are building and what we are leaving out.
notes.emphasise: One positioning statement runs through every page.
notes.pushback: Can the positioning change later? Yes, if the practice's priorities change, and we would update the plan.

slides.headline: Same-day emergency care is what sets Larkspur apart from every Boise competitor
slides.message: The calm, same-day family practice that treats emergencies and implants under one roof.

notes.say: Same-day emergency care leads the homepage because it is the fastest-growing service and the topic no competitor has a page for. Sedation and the review rating back it up.
notes.pushback: Is the claim safe? Outcome claims are kept factual and reviewed by Dr. Okafor before they go live.
